content: SQLx provides compile-time checked queries through the query!() macro. It connects to a development database at compile time to verify SQL syntax and type compatibility. The macro returns an anonymous struct with fields matching the SELECT columns. For dynamic queries, query_as() maps results to a named struct implementing FromRow. SQLx supports PostgreSQL, MySQL, and SQLite with feature flags.

Diesel uses a schema.rs file generated by diesel print-schema to represent the database structure in Rust types. Each table becomes a module with columns as associated types. Migrations are managed through diesel migration generate/run/revert commands. The QueryDsl trait provides a builder pattern for constructing type-safe queries without raw SQL strings.
